Satellite Tyvak-0173 (SIRION-3, EG 3, EG-3, EchoStar Global 3)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 16U
Status Operational (News on 2021-12-06 about propulsion)
Launched 2021-06-30
NORAD ID 48892
Deployer Unknown
Launcher Falcon 9 (Transporter-2)
Entity name EchoStar
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Nation US
Manufacturer AIVT by Terran Orbital
Oneliner

Two tiny S-band satellites to jumpstart a low-Earth-orbit constellation using spectrum gained through its acquisition of Helios Wire. 
Results

Performed 110 km in altitude orbit raise from TLEs as reported by Jonathan McDowell.
The orbit raising required about 65 meters per second.
Jonathan McDowell reported on 2021-12-03 that new TLE out today for Echostar EG-3 (48892) shows it in a 650 x 677 km x 96.0 deg orbit - first TLE in a month, Nov 3 it was in a 644 x 666 x 97.5 deg orbit, corresponding to a 1.5 deg inclination change. It is about 200 m/s.
Notes

Not officially acknowledged, but very likely EchoStar CubeSat. Seems larger than 6U.
